name: CD45
evidence: the kinetic-segregation model: large phosphatases are excluded by size from close contacts; the large ectodomain of CD45 regulates its segregation from the ligated T-cell receptor

name: CD45RO
evidence: the short isoform, without residues 34-194 of the canonical sequence (UniProt P08575-4): 38 disordered residues with 4 predicted glycosites stand on the same folded region; about 22 nm by electron microscopy

name: CD148
evidence: the large ectodomain of CD148 regulates its segregation from the ligated T-cell receptor
